Hi all — ran the numbers; attaching a compact workbook (pricing-scenarios-inkwell.xlsx) and SOW draft to speed the legal path if you want to move. High-level takeaways below.

Assumptions: baseline list price = $1,200 per 1M tokens (hosted inference standard tier). Committed discounts are progressive by band. Founders credit is a one-time customer credit applied to invoices in the first 90 days and can be combined with a committed discount up to a limit.

Scenario A — 12-month commit @ 6M/month (72M tokens total annually)
- Committed discount: 35% at 6M/month (applied to list)
- Effective price: $780 / 1M tokens
- Monthly bill: ~$4,680
- Notes: hits Sofia’s upper target ($650–750) only if we consider an additional 10% promotional founders credit (one-time spread), which would bring the effective first-quarter blended price to ~$700/1M. Requires an approval for founders credit > standard starter credit.

Scenario B — 6-month commit @ 3.5M/month + founders credit $6k applied in month 1
- Committed discount: 25% at 3.5M/month
- Effective after discount: $900 / 1M tokens
- Blended first 6 months w/ founders credit: effective ~$780/1M (credit amortized)
- Fallback month-to-month after 6 months: $1,200 / 1M (list) or a reduced no-commit tier at $1,050 / 1M if they enroll in our startup program formally.

Recommendation: Offer Scenario A with a one-time promotional founders credit of up to 10% (approval required). That combination lands the effective $/1M in the $700–780 range — inside Sofia’s stretch target if we can approve the promo credit. Scenario B is lower commitment but more expensive long-run; good for risk-averse pilots.

Next actions: 
- Tessa: confirm which scenario Inkwell prefers and whether they can sign a 12-month MSA or need a pilot SOW.
- Sofia: if you can share the Spark Labs letter and a brief one-pager from procurement we’ll include it in the approval pack.
- Laura: can you advise on a one-off founders credit approval path (what level I can approve vs. what needs ops/finance sign-off)?

Attachments: pricing-scenarios-inkwell.xlsx, SOW-draft-inkwell.pdf

Thanks — Rishi
